#  13036 - Selected Topics in Quantum Theory II Modulübersicht  
|  Module Number:   | **13036 - module is no longer offered from SS 2023**  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Module Title:  | **Selected Topics in Quantum Theory II**  |  
|  Ausgewählte Kapitel der Quantentheorie II   |  
| Department:  |  Faculty 1 - Mathematics, Computer Science, Physics, Electrical Engineering and Information Technology   |  
| Responsible Staff Member:  | 
  * Prof. Dr. rer. nat. habil. Bestehorn, Michael 

 |  
| Language of Teaching / Examination:  | English  |  
| Duration:  | 1 semester  |  
| Frequency of Offer:  |  Each summer semester odd year   |  
| Credits:  |  
| Learning Outcome:  | After successfully completing the module, students have a broad understanding of quantum theory.Analyzing concrete examples, the students master methods of gaining knowledge, establishing a methodology, theory development, classification of physical findings etc.Furthermore, the student can apply their social skills such as the ability to cooperate and other individual skills such as diligence, perseverance, curiosity, initiative, etc.  |  
| Contents:  | 
  * Scattering theory
  * Green's functions
  * Few-Body Theory
  * Many-Body Theory

 |  
| Recommended Prerequisites:  | 
  * Knowledge of quantum mechanics for a bachelor's Physics degree.

 |  
| Mandatory Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Forms of Teaching and Proportion:  | 
  * Lecture / 2 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Exercise / 2 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Self organised studies / 120 Hours 

 |  
| Teaching Materials and Literature:  | 
  * A. Galindo, P. Pascual, Quantum Mechanics
  * A. Böhm, Quantum Mechanics
  * Schwabl, Advanced Quantum Mechanics
  * Nolting, Many-Body Theory

 |  
| Module Examination:  | Final Module Examination (MAP)  |  
| Assessment Mode for Module Examination:  | 
  * Oral examination, 30-45 min.

 |  
| Evaluation of Module Examination:  | Performance Verification – graded  |  
| Limited Number of Participants:  | None  |  
| Part of the Study Programme:  | 
  * no assignment

 |  
| Remarks:  | 
  * Study programme Physics M.Sc.: Compulsory elective module in complex „Physical Specialization with Theoretical Focus“, topic area „Theory, Simulation and further topics“
  * Study programme Applied Mathematics M.Sc.: Compulsory elective module in field of application „Physik“

The self-study consists of: 
  * reworking of the lecture
  * preparation of demonstrations as well as exercises

 |  
| Module Components:  | 
  * Lecture: Selected Topics of Quantum Theory II (2 Hours per Week per Semester)
  * Accompanying exercises (2 Hours per Week per Semester)
  * Related examination

 |  
| Components to be offered in the Current Semester:  | 
  * no assignment

 |  
| Follow-up Module/s:  |  Phase-out module since: 10.01.2023 
  * without Follow-up Module/s

 |
